title: Conjecture 1.4 — Shorey
exact_target: Is the perfect-power exponent bounded in terms only of the number and size of nonzero coefficients, unless cancellation occurs in a proper subset of the equation terms?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8700003 (AMR-086-0003). CC BY 4.0.
